android.desc: Lingo Journal helps you track your language learning experience. FEATURES: · Track activities in different categories - Reading, Writing, Listening, Speaking, General Learning and Other · Assign or create activity types - like "Reading a book", "Speaking with a native", "Learning vocabulary in Duolingo", etc. · Set goals and establish habits - Daily or Long-term goals will keep you focused and motivated · Track your confidence and motivation · Keep notes · Track multiple languages at the same time · Challenge yourself with streaks - Lingo Journal keeps a separate streak count for each language · Daily, Monthly & Yearly statistics - Top activities, category spread, hours spent, streaks, average confidence and motivation · Daily reminders · Dark mode Learning a language is a fascinating journey, but not always an easy one. In order to achieve fluency, we need to practice often, and in as many different ways as possible. However, it can be difficult to actually see progress and stay motivated! Lingo Journal is here to help you set your goals, establish language learning habits, and track your efforts. 130+ supported languages. Learn a new language in a way that suits your style and use Lingo Journal to set your goals and track your language learning activities for Spanish, French, German, Italian, Russian, Danish, Swedish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Korean, Esperanto, Polish, Greek, Hungarian, Norwegian, Hebrew, Welsh, Arabic, Portuguese, Turkish, Dutch, Irish, Latin, Hawaiian, Scottish Gaelic, Japanese, English and many more. Lingo Journal is in active development. New features are already in the pipeline. I'm doing my best to improve the app, so let me know what features you would like to have. Enjoy!✌️
